messages:
Maria: Quick sync — proposing tenant-specific deprecation thresholds for v1->v2. idea: per-route 7-day rolling > X% v1 traffic -> console warning -> notify SEs. want opinions on metric and dashboard surface :thinking:
Liam: +1 on per-route. question: X% is it request-count or token-weighted? token-weighted feels closer to cost impact :money_with_wings:
Sam: Token-weighted makes sense for billing, but for UX we also care about user-visible failures. maybe two thresholds: token (cost) + error-rate or silent-fallback-rate :rotating_light:
Maria: Yep — proposal sketch: (1) token_share >= 30% for 7d => Console Warning (banner + notification). (2) fallback_rate >= 1% for 24h => Escalation -> oncall. (3) hard cut only after tenant opts out/consents or after manual approval. Thoughts?
Priya: Telemetry note: we need a stable event name and dimensions. propose `api.versioning.deprecation_signal` with dims: tenant_id, route_id, metric_type(token|requests|fallback|errors), window_days. also add `sample_rate` label so we know how many tenants we actually computed on.
Liam: Agree on event name. Also we should emit a continuous gauge per-route: `console.v1_share_pct` and `console.v1_fallback_p95` so dashboards can plot trends.
Maria: Good — console UX question: do we surface tenant thresholds in the banner or link to a per-tenant analysis page? prefer link to analysis + CTA `Contact SE / Request dev mode`.
Sam: Link + CTA ok. For high-volume tenants we should include a "what changed" diff: recent client library versions, header drops, or agent proxies. makes triage faster.
Priya: For sampling: compute full-resolution for tenants > X TPS, otherwise sample every N minutes. need to record sampling method in telemetry.
Liam: Implementation detail: route_id is sometimes ambiguous for proxy clients. let's canonicalize on `routeset_id` or fallback to `customer_route` tag. add a mapping table recorded in event `route_mapping.v1` so we can reconcile.
Maria: Good call. also need quota implications: if we warn but keep v1 enabled, we may overcharge or misattribute. ops: should warning change quota smoothing? Sam?
Sam: I suggest not to change quota automatically. But show a projected quota delta if tenant migrates to v2 (cost delta estimator). Console can offer an autosuggest config: `suggest_batching=true` or `suggest_quant=true` with expected % savings.
Maria: Copy for console banner: short + link. draft: "Your integration is still calling v1 for 32% of tokens over the last 7 days. See migration tips & estimated cost impact -> [link]." keep it actionable.
Priya: For alerts: alerting rules should be based on the telemetry event stream, not console-derived summary, so ops can plug into pager. propose a stable prometheus rule too: `redwood_v1_token_share{tenant_id=~"..."} > 0.3` over 7d.
Liam: How do we surface historical baselines? tenants sometimes have seasonal spikes. maybe use anomaly detection (rolling baseline) and only trigger if current share > baseline + X sigma OR absolute threshold.
Maria: Good point — add both: absolute threshold + baseline-relative delta. That reduces noisy banners.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline note: `deprecations/telemetry` feature branch will include DB schema changes for `route_mapping` and the new events. rolling deploy planned Thu 03:00 UTC. runbook PR: #4023.
Sam: Action items: (1) Priya to document event schema + sampling. (2) Liam to add metrics/gauges + route_mapping export. (3) UX to draft banner & analysis page copy (Maria). (4) Ops to schedule deploy and add prometheus rules (ops-bot).
Maria: Thx — can each of you drop a one-liner in PRs and I'll assemble a single console mock for the eng-review? aiming to ship soft-warn in 2 sprints. :rocket:
Liam: I'll open metric PR today and include a grafana panel mock.
Priya: I'll post event schema in the thread once done.
Sam: I'll sketch the cost estimator and the migration checklist items.
console-bot: Note: console feature-flag `v1_deprec_banners` default=off. enable in staging next Tue.
Maria: Perfect. closing the loop — we'll reconvene after PRs. if anyone sees an obvious missing signal (e.g., client header strip), ping here and we can add to the diff analysis. :white_check_mark:
